quest.title: Tons of Tons of Furious Fish...
quest.description: Sigewinne seems to have something to tell us...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Hehe... Well-behaved little fish swimming to and fro in spacious, carefully arranged tanks...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: It really is a beautiful sight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's why our aquarium's so popular!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: If only they were this well-behaved in open waters... then people could dive down and immerse themselves more deeply in the beauty of the natural world.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Anyway, thanks to your help, I've got to the bottom of why these fish were so agitated...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Over the years, there have been plenty of shipwrecks, and even some absolute scoundrels illegally dumping waste in the sea...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: A huge amount of man-made junk has sunk to the seabed, piling up and destroying natural habitats. It's this that's caused the fish to become increasingly aggressive...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Apparently, a group of divers has already accepted a commission to clean up the junk.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: But it looks like I'll have to give them a polite kick up the backside and ask them to pick up the pace...

choices.text: Sounds like it might take some time before we see results...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Yes. In the meantime, let's continue our work by bringing in as many aggressive little fish as possible to help them relax and recuperate.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Isolating the patients from their harmful environment is an important step on the road to recovery.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Got it! Just leave it to us! We'll keep our eyes peeled for new patients.

choices.text: I imagine this sort of job isn't going to be quick to complete...
